quote.text: Beauty is the mystery of life. It is not in the eye, it is in the mind.
quote.english: Beauty is the mystery of life. It is not in the eye, it is in the mind.
quote.where: Beauty Is the Mystery of Life, 1989

poem.text:
Wer jetzt kein Haus hat, baut sich keines mehr.
Wer jetzt allein ist, wird es lange bleiben,
wird wachen, lesen, lange Briefe schreiben
und wird in den Alleen hin und her
unruhig wandern, wenn die Blätter treiben.
poem.english:
Whoever has no house now will not build one.
Whoever is alone now will stay alone:
will sit up, read, write long letters,
and wander the avenues, back and forth,
restless, as the leaves drift down.
poem.note: Written in Paris in a single September day, at twenty-six, while he was working as Rodin's secretary and learning to look at things.
poem.translator: translated for this page, not a published version
